response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with strong full-stack, testing, and open-source credentials, but does not meet the core hard requirement of 8 years of C++ programming — the resume shows roughly six months of C/C++ work at National Instruments plus a university thesis project. Distributed-systems exposure is real (low-latency D services handling high request volumes at Sociomantic) but is not at the scale of an internal cloud compute platform, and there is no evidence of formal technical leadership, cloud compute/hardware architecture ownership, or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. The profile reads as a product/web-oriented craftsman rather than a systems-level compute platform lead.
strengths: Broad 15+ year track record across web, mobile, embedded and backend systems
Strong engineering-practice culture: TDD, CI/CD, open-source tooling, teaching and workshops
concerns: C++ experience far below the 8-year minimum (~6 months professional)
No formal technical leadership or team-mentoring role listed
Limited large-scale cloud compute, storage, or hardware architecture depth
